This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #6172: High CPU usage (100%+) during LLM streaming - O(n) text buffer rendering causing performance degradation
- #6548: Virtualized scrolling + paginated message loading for long sessions - direct feature request for this problem
- #3746: Long prompt history stalls the app, long load time
- #7893: Severe scroll lag in VSCode/Cursor integrated terminal after large output
- #5361: TUI freezes periodically (also affects conversation loading)

The root cause appears to be O(n) rendering complexity in the text buffer that recalculates for all content, not just visible content. This is tracked as a performance issue in the opentui component.

Feel free to ignore if your specific case differs from these.
